concept.headline: Bread worth getting up early for.
concept.subheadline: Sourdough, croissants and celebration cakes, made by hand every morning on Main Street in Westbrook. Order ahead and we'll have it boxed and waiting.

services.name: Country sourdough
services.description: Made with the same starter we've kept going since we opened.

services.name: Croissants and pastries
services.description: Laminated by hand over three days, out of the oven before we open.

services.name: Seeded rye
services.description: Dense and nutty, and the best sandwich bread in town.

services.name: Celebration cakes
services.description: Birthdays, weddings and everything in between. Give us three days.

concept.story: The Russo family opened Marigold in 1984 with one oven and a sourdough starter. Forty years later we still bake everything by hand, before sunrise, right here in Westbrook.

testimonials.quote: The sourdough is the real thing: a proper crust, a tangy open crumb, and it keeps for days.
testimonials.author: Kate M.

concept.final_heading: Come hungry. We'll have something warm.
improvements: Your hours and phone number are right at the top
